name: grasso_screw_catalogue_r717
title: Screw compressor from catalogue data (Grasso C-52, R717)
summary: Catalogue-data model of an R717 Grasso C-52 screw compressor from the 2002 Laborelec compressor toolkit: the 24 manufacturer rows (condensing/evaporating temperature, capacity, electrical power) are read from a lookup table and turned into the global isentropic and volumetric effectiveness versus pressure ratio, plus a part-load correction at PLF = 0.42.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of the source file (701 variables stored, 656 common): 144 differ, all absolute h/s reference-state offsets EES vs CoolProp R717; all 512 derived results pass rtol 1e-3 (worst 9.51e-04 on epsilon_v_cp_mes[11]).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0284 (Catalogue_data_model-Grasso C-52 - 2490rpm.EES, EES X6.596, 701 stored values); tools/compare_solution.py on a reference converted by hand from kPa/kJ to Pa/J
verification.notes: compare_solution.py prints: 656 common variables, 144 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 45; only in CoolSolve: 25. The 144 are the absolute enthalpies (h_ex_cd, h_ex_ev, h_exs_cp, h_su_cp, h_su_ev) and the supply entropy s_su_cp: a pure reference-state offset (CoolProp - EES: h +145.12..+145.53 kJ/kg, s +482.2..+482.5 J/kg-K), as allowed by the verification policy. Max. rel. diff over all common variables 0.331 (h_ex_cd[1], the offset); over the 512 derived results 9.51e-04 on epsilon_v_cp_mes[11], within the 0.1 % real-fluid property tolerance EES 6.596 vs CoolProp ammonia. Only in EES: the stale records M_dot_cp_mes[1..25] (commented-out equation), the index-25 records of 16 array variables (an earlier n = 25) and the DUPLICATE index i. Only in CoolSolve: fluid$ (string) and t_su_cp[1..24], which the EES stored solution does not contain (checked by hand: t_su_cp = T_ev + 5.001 K).
